# Birane DIAW — OHMEGA

Canonical website: https://b-diaw.com/

Birane DIAW is a State Engineering Student focused on electrical engineering and intelligent systems. The portfolio presents research and engineering case studies in power systems, smart grids, VSC-HVDC, grid-forming control, renewable energy, industrial automation, digital twins and embedded electronics.

## Research

- Grid-Forming Virtual Synchronous Machine Control with DC-Coupled Battery Storage for Frequency Stability in a Multi-Terminal VSC-HVDC Renewable Power System
- Journal of Undergraduate Research International, KFUPM
- Manuscript accepted for publication; DOI forthcoming.

## Selected engineering case studies

- https://b-diaw.com/projects/ufls-smartgrid — Smart-Grid UFLS Relay — ONEE & SENELEC
- https://b-diaw.com/projects/wave-energy-conversion — Wave-Energy Conversion Chain — PMSG, FOC & Grid Injection
- https://b-diaw.com/projects/railway-traction-25kv — 25 kV AC Railway Traction System
- https://b-diaw.com/projects/digital-twin-liion-battery — Digital Twin — Li-ion Battery Packs
- https://b-diaw.com/projects/digital-twin-electric-drive — Digital Twin — Variable-Speed Electric Drive
